description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for three different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, and Inconsistency-CE-MP. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," is also a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2. The data for the Consistency-CE model is represented by a light purple dashed line with circular markers, showing a steady increase from a BLEU score of approximately 20.2 at an AL of 1 to about 29.7 at an AL of 8. The Inconsistency-CE model is shown with a dark purple dashed line and square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 22.3 at an AL of 1 and increasing to about 29.9 at an AL of 8. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model is represented by a blue dashed line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 22.3 at an AL of 1 and rising to about 29.4 at an AL of 8. The red dashed line with star markers, which represents the Inconsistency-CE-MP model, shows a consistent upward trend, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 24.8 at an AL of 1 and reaching a peak of about 30.1 at an AL of 8.
